newsitem.title: SPAIN: SYNCHRONISED SWIMMING-SEDAKOVA MAKES IT FOUR IN A ROW.
newsitem.headline: SYNCHRONISED SWIMMING-SEDAKOVA MAKES IT FOUR IN A ROW.

text.p: Olga Sedakova became the first woman to win four consecutive European solo synchronised swimming titles when she triumphed in Seville on Friday.
The Russian beat the record held by Britain's Carolyn Wilson, who won three times between 1981 and 1985.
It was also Sedakova's ninth European title, which also include gold medals in duet and team events.
Performing to the music 'Nick of Time' she scored 99.24 points, a mark unprecedented in European championship history.
